reason: Clearing debris seems like a useful start to repairing the wound.
expectation: The phagocytes will clear some wound debris, preparing the area for repair.

alternatives.reason: A capillary response may support repair, but I want to address the wound debris first.

effect: The wound is cleared of debris, so I can move on to supporting tissue repair.
reaction: The result matched my expectation, though it added little explanation.
reason: A capillary response may help supply the repairing tissue.
expectation: Repair signals will prompt the nearby capillary to contribute to the wound's blood supply.

alternatives.reason: Fibroblasts and nutrients may build supporting tissue, but I want to establish its blood supply first.

effect: The repair signals produced a new vessel branch connected to the circulation, ready to contribute to the wound.
reaction: The growing branch makes its connection to the existing blood supply clear.
reason: Adding the capillary sprout should help supply the wound as it repairs.
expectation: The sprout will become part of the repairing wound and help supply it with blood.

alternatives.reason: Fibroblasts may build supporting tissue, but I want to connect the new vessel first.

effect: The capillary sprout is now connected to the healing wound, which still needs surface and support layers.
reaction: The named slots make the remaining repair tasks clear.
reason: Fibroblasts and nutrients seem useful for building the wound's supporting tissue.
expectation: The fibroblasts will use the nutrients to make material that supports the healing wound.

alternatives.reason: Surface cells also need to close the wound, but I want to build support first.

effect: The fibroblasts made new connective tissue by laying collagen in the damaged dermis, ready to provide support.
reaction: The picture makes the fibroblasts' contribution clear.
reason: Adding the new connective tissue should fill the wound's support slot.
expectation: The connective tissue will support the healing wound, while the surface still needs closing.

alternatives.reason: The edge cells could help close the surface, but I want to add the support tissue first.

effect: The wound now has new connective tissue for support, but still needs its surface closed.
reaction: The reminder that young tissue is weaker than uninjured skin adds useful context.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should help restore the wound surface.
expectation: The edge cells will use the nutrients to produce a surface layer that can close the wound.

effect: The edge cells formed a new surface sheet that can fill the remaining wound slot.
reaction: The picture clearly shows the surface growing across the gap.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should close the wound surface.
expectation: The new surface will cover the gap above the supporting tissue; the temporary clot may still need clearing.

effect: The wound is closed and supported, leaving the temporary clot to be cleared.
reaction: The reminder that deeper tissue is still gaining strength makes the closure feel like a stage of repair.
reason: This is the only offered combination and addresses the remaining goal.
expectation: The enzymes will break down the temporary clot as the wound heals.

effect: The temporary clot has mostly been cleared, while the new tissue and maturing scar remain. Both goals are complete.
reaction: The distinction between clearing the clot and continued scar maturation made the ending feel like a stage in healing.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making and fitting the connective tissue was most worthwhile: it connected fibroblasts laying down collagen with support beneath the wound, while explaining that young tissue is still weaker.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cleaning the wound was a sensible start, but its result added little explanation beyond the picture.

surprise.text: I appreciated that closing the surface did not mean repair was finished: the deeper tissue was still gaining strength, and the scar would continue to mature.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary. The named surface and support slots made the fittings understandable, though the compatible menu guided the choices.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the sequence made the overlapping jobs of wound repair clear, although several fitting steps felt predictable.
